subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Problem: Acme needs predictable, low-latency inference for their recommendations pipeline across multi-region shopping traffic.
- What we discussed: Redwood runtime + Dedicated deployment for predictable throughput; options for private VPC for sensitive PII workflows; initial perf targets (tail latency < 150ms, 5k reqs/min steady).
- Action items we agreed:
  1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO level) to confirm architecture and procurement runway.
  2) Technical deep dive with your infra/ML infra team to validate latency numbers and integration points.

To unblock the exec alignment, I wanted to introduce Vivek (cc'd) — he'll join the VP/CTO call and handle contractual/commitment questions. Can you confirm who from your side should join at the VP/CTO level? I suggest the following slots (PST):

- Thu 12/10 10:00 - 10:30am PST
- Thu 12/10 3:00 - 3:30pm PST
- Fri 12/11 9:00 - 9:30am PST

If none of those work, reply with a few times and we'll do our best to align. I've attached the 15-min exec summary deck (MCC-demo-deck.pdf) and a draft SOW outline for budget context (SOW-draft-v1.pdf).

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Quick answers:

- Execs: Our CTO (Bob Patel) and VP Product (Sofia Martinez) should join the alignment call.
- Tech deep dive: Our ML infra lead, Daniel Kim, will be the primary technical contact.

Of the times you suggested, Thu 12/10 3:00pm PST works best for Bob and Sofia. Can we block 30 minutes? If possible, please add a calendar invite and include a short agenda so Bob knows it's an architecture alignment rather than a vendor demo.

Also, Daniel asked if we can share a short doc with current inference QPS and baseline latencies — I'll attach that in a follow-up.

Thanks,
